videos.title: ChatGPT Space: 7 Incredible Use Cases You Need To Try
videos.ai_tech_id: OpenAI ChatGPT — new Space and Pages workspace features
summary: Paul J Lipsky explores ChatGPT's new Space and Pages features, OpenAI's workspace-style additions that let users organize conversations and turn them into persistent, shareable documents rather than disposable chat threads.

He walks through seven practical use cases with timestamped chapters: co-writing documents inside a Space, converting an existing chat into a standalone Page, Pages that automatically update over time, visual brainstorming, sharing interactive reports with others, collaborating with teammates inside a shared Space, and generating structured meeting notes.

The video is sponsored by Abacus AI's ChatLLM platform, and Lipsky frames Space and Pages as a shift toward treating ChatGPT as an ongoing workspace for documents and projects rather than a one-off question-and-answer tool.

videos.title: 3 Unhinged Job Interview Hacks to Try Before You Leave
videos.ai_tech_id: OpenAI ChatGPT — used as a research and interview-prep assistant
summary: Sabrina Ramonov shares three unconventional moves for the final minutes of a job interview, using OpenAI's ChatGPT as a research and preparation tool rather than presenting any single tool as the hack itself.

The three tactics are: asking the interviewer directly whether anything from the interview would prevent you from being their top choice and then listening rather than talking; prompting ChatGPT to research the hiring manager's public social media presence and likely motivations ahead of the meeting; and asking ChatGPT to generate three questions designed to get the interviewer talking at length, since people who talk more tend to rate the conversation more positively.

She frames these as ways to leave an interview with fewer unanswered doubts about where you stand, cautions viewers to verify any research themselves and use it for genuine preparation rather than manipulation, and notes that none of the steps guarantees a job offer.
